{{Infobox auto}}
'''Hellbricks''' are a dark brick block from [[Hell]]. They are the vanilla {{MCW|Nether Bricks|nether bricks}} under a new name, with a near-black texture. The family also includes [[#Variants|cracked, chiseled and red hellbricks]] and the slabs, stairs, walls and fence of the vanilla set.

== Obtaining ==
=== Cooking and crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Hellbricks can be made two ways:
* Four [[Hellbrick|hellbrick]] items in a square, as in vanilla.
* By cooking one [[hellstone]] in an [[oven]] for 10 seconds. This gives a full block from a single hellstone, where the crafting route needs four blast-furnace hellbricks.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/nether_bricks_from_smelting_netherrack.json}}</ref>

=== Natural generation ===
[[Nether Fortress|Nether fortresses]] are built from hellbricks, hellbrick fences and stairs, because the blocks keep their vanilla IDs.

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}

== Variants ==
=== Cracked Hellbricks ===
Cracked hellbricks are made by cooking hellbricks in a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]] (5 seconds). The vanilla furnace recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/cracked_nether_bricks.json}}</ref>
{{Recipes|Cracked Hellbricks}}

=== Chiseled Hellbricks ===
Chiseled hellbricks can only be made in a [[stonecutter]]. The vanilla recipe from two slabs is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>
{{Recipes|Chiseled Hellbricks}}

=== Red Hellbricks ===
Red hellbricks are made from two [[Hellbrick|hellbricks]] and two [[hellspore]], as in vanilla.
{{Recipes|Red Hellbricks}}

=== Slabs, stairs, walls and fence ===
Hellbricks and red hellbricks each have a slab, stairs and a wall, and hellbricks also have a fence. A stonecutter cuts one block of hellbricks into 3 hellbrick fences.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/stonecutting/nether_brick_fence_from_stonecutting_nether_bricks.json}}</ref> Two slabs of either kind craft back into the full block.
